When's the best time to see Jupiter's auroras?

Good news: Jupiter's auroras never switch off! 🌌 They're brightest 2 to 3 days after a solar flare, when the solar wind hits. Most of the glow is ultraviolet, so the Galileo Cruiser's observation deck has UV filters that let you see it.
